findings.message: The test case authenticates as warehouse_operator and expects successful approval, while the supplied requirement authorizes approval only for sales_manager; no supported oracle for warehouse_operator is provided, so the role or expected behavior requires a product decision.
evidence: REQ-AUTH-001.text=Only sales_manager may approve an order through POST /api/v1/orders/{order_id}/approve; a successful approval returns HTTP 200 with status APPROVED.
TC-AUTH-001.expected_outcome=HTTP 200 is returned with status APPROVED.
